title: Program Designer, Curriculum
description:
The Organization: Merit America

The American economy is broken. Today, 53 million working adults-nearly half of the U.S. workforce-do not earn a living wage. These talented workers have few options to advance: college is too long and expensive, full-time boot camp programs don’t offer enough flexibility, and online courses don’t have the structure or support to translate learning into a new career. The result? Talented workers, disproportionately people of color and women, get stuck in low-wage roles with no way to build a better life for themselves and their families.

Merit America is a national nonprofit that creates pathways to family-sustaining careers for Americans stuck in low-wage work. Our fast, flexible solutions are built for working adults: We start by analyzing tens of millions of job postings to identify in-demand, high-paying tech careers and then work with industry-recognized partners to train for these roles with part-time programs that combine flexible online learning with best-in-class coaching. Finally, we support our learners in their job search, helping them connect with a broad constellation of local and national employers such as JPMorgan Chase and Infosys to land higher-earning, family-sustaining jobs. Merit America is on a mission to build a scalable pathway for workers to join the middle class through merit, not money. Since our founding in 2018, we’ve generated a projected $1 billion in near-term wage gains for our learners.

Role Overview
As a Program Designer at Merit America , you will be central to developing and enhancing our learning solutions and program models. This role focuses on creating effective, industry-aligned curricula and program frameworks that drive learner success and scalability. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Coaching, Operations, and Admissions, to integrate best practices and innovative strategies into our programs. Your role combines strategic planning with hands-on execution, leveraging data-driven insights to continuously improve our offerings. Day-to-day, you will collaborate with teams to design, test, and refine curriculum resources and coaching strategies, directly supporting learners through customized programs while continuously analyzing data to ensure the content aligns with industry needs and learner success.
The Program Designer position is an exempt role reporting directly to the Director, Program Experience & Innovation. You will primarily collaborate with the Program team and frequently engage with other functional areas at Merit America . This role requires a strong commitment to our mission and values, a proven ability to drive innovation and continuous improvement, and the capability to balance high-level strategic goals with day-to-day operational excellence.

• Develop and deliver integrated curriculum strategies that support learners from onboarding through job success, driving engagement, retention, and career outcomes.

• Design and maintain curriculum resources across learning tracks that align with industry standards, employer demands, and learner needs.

• Utilize data insights and learner feedback to refine curriculum content and instructional methods, improving performance and learner support processes.

• Maintain standards of excellence in curriculum, ensuring consistent delivery across tracks in a virtual environment.

• Train and support coaches, equipping them with up-to-date tools, content, and resources that enhance learner experiences and outcomes.

title: Global Head of Real Estate and Workplace
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

About the Role

We are growing our geographic footprint and opening multiple workspaces and event spaces across the U.S. and internationally. Most of these locations serve a dual purpose. They are working spaces for Deepgram employees and public event venues that host meetups, hackathons, and customer and developer gatherings. Designing and operating space that does both well is a key aspect of this role.

Right now, real estate decisions, office openings, construction projects, and facilities operations are spread across many people. We need one responsible and experienced owner who knows how to do this all end to end. Someone who can read a lease, walk a construction site, manage a vendor, and think clearly about how a space shapes culture, brand, and community.

As Global Head of Real Estate and Workplace, you will take full ownership of Deepgram's physical spaces from site selection through to operational, welcoming offices. You will find potential real estate, negotiate and manage leases, run buildout projects, stand up facilities operations, and build the repeatable playbook we use to open and run every Deepgram location. Then you will hire and lead a small team to run it with you.

This is a player-coach role. You will be in the work, not above it, and you will build the function as you go.

What You'll Own

Requirements Scoping & Internal Stakeholder Management

- Converting the CEO and executive team’s vision into a documented program for each site

- Gathering requirements across Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Developer Relations, People, IT, Security, and Finance to determine how each space will be used and what it needs to solve for

- Reconciling competing requests into a single prioritized brief, secure executive approval, and own that brief as the source of truth for architects, general contractors, and all subsequent change decisions

Capacity & Space Planning

- Recommendations on the size, timing, and location of new and expanded space, grounded in utilization data

We manage billing, credentialing, and account management for private dermatology practices nationwide, and we are expanding those operations into orthopedics. We are building the team that grows with us.

This role is for a certified coder who brings versatility. You will primarily support our core dermatology accounts while using your orthopedic knowledge to support our expanding musculoskeletal line of business. You will not be plugging in codes in a silo. You will own coding integrity for a defined set of clients and support account managers across specialties, touching client compliance, denial resolution, and payer navigation along the way.

The people who thrive here are the ones who find the documentation gaps before they cause denials, ask sharp questions, and figure things out.

•
Code across specialties. Own documentation quality. Validate provider notes against current E/M leveling guidelines on both office visits and procedure-heavy encounters, and go directly to practice managers and physicians when something is incomplete or ambiguous. They are not coding experts. You are.

Resolve denials. Research and work complex coding-related denials across major payers. Understand why a claim was denied and execute the right path forward, using approved AI tools to draft stronger appeals and move faster.

Certified and versatile. Active AAPC credential, 1 to 2 years of medical coding experience, strong dermatology expertise. Orthopedic coding experience is a major plus.

AI-native. You already use AI tools in your work, or you are actively curious about how they can make you better. You think about efficiency, not just effort.

Clear and steady under pressure. Practice managers and providers can be demanding. You stay calm, give straight compliance-backed answers, and follow through.

•
Here to contribute, not to be developed. We will give you exposure across multiple specialties in a scaling business. What you do with it is on you.

What We Offer

• 90% employer-covered health, dental, and vision

• Remote, full-time position

• Real exposure to every element of a scaling RCM operation

• A team that moves fast and rewards people who do the same

About the Role

As a product designer on Codex, you’ll collaborate closely with a small team of product designers and cross-functional partners to shape the future of coding. You’ll partner closely with world-class engineers and researchers to bring cutting-edge capabilities into the hands of developers. Much of the work is 0-1, requiring you to balance a high-bar for craft, fast iteration, and strong product intuition. You’ll work on the end-to-end design of new features and improvements across a range of Codex products. You’ll help chart our course into the future as we evolve our technology, product, and design paradigms.

 

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Contribute to the overall design and product direction of OpenAI products.

- Design and ship high-quality products and improvements, from early concepts to high-fidelity prototypes and visuals.

- Partner closely with engineering, product management, research, and design peers to define both long-term strategy and short-term tactics.

- Engage in user research to better understand our users (software developers) and refine our products.

- Contribute to and evolve our design system.

- Help establish our design culture and grow our team.

 

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Bring a strong technical background and have recently shipped code to production.

- Are deeply motivated by making coding agents intuitive and accessible, and expanding access to who can build software.

- Have a portfolio showcasing strong UX, UI, and interaction design skills, with a high bar for quality and craft.

- Enjoy 0 -> 1 environments, can navigate ambiguity, and bring crisp design thinking to technical trade-offs.

- Get excited about being immersed in the AI research process and defining how AI-first products should look and behave.

- Possess impactful communication and storytelling skills.

 

Bonus if you have:

- Prior experience with research or developer-focused products or workflows.

- Have shipped side projects with AI or contributed to open-source AI tools.
